t: Men's Rebel by Durango Steel Toe Flag Western Flag Boots (DB020)
d:
Details 
 Having distressed full-grain brown leather positioned along the collar, pull straps and foot of these Rebel™ by Durango® Western boots contrasts nicely with the man-made flag shaft. The square-toe boots have an almost worn-in look, which allows them have a more stylish appearance than a traditional pair of work boots.
 A double row of welt stitching ensures that the footwear holds together nicely. The steel toe (compliant with the ASTM F2413 Protective Toe Classification) is extremely beneficial to have in these pull-on boots, because it will shield your feet from feeling the full impact of heavy items that drop unexpectedly.
 The interior of these men's 11"   Western boots   has been fully lined; you will appreciate how lightweight, breathable and soft the material is. The removable footbed supplies tremendous cushioning for the bottoms of your feet. Then there is the tempered steel shank that has been constructed into the base; it provides optimal steadiness and supports the arches of your feet terrifically well.
 The midsole alleviates the heaviness of your steps and provides additional cushioning, which allows you to wear these men's boots comfortably throughout the entire day. As a whole, the rubber outsole is very flexible, lightweight and extremely durable; underneath, the flag graphics provide a cool visual effect.
 When you pull on these Rebel™ by Durango® men's Western steel-toe boots, you'll receive fantastic protection for your feet, while being able to enjoy the footwear's fine appearance and comfortable fit.
- Square toe
- EVA midsole
- Tempered steel shank
- Double row welt stitch
- Rolled shank area
- Soft mesh lining
- Goodyear® welt construction
- Distressed full-grain leather foot, collar and pull straps with faux shaft
